title: Jigsaw
notes: studio_or_developer holds the infobox distributor; production companies not checked.

in_universe.label: ~10 years after Saw III
in_universe.note: The present-day portion of Jigsaw takes place roughly ten years after John's death in Saw III. Disputed: the chronology table lists it ninth, but its footnote says "According to Entertainment Weekly, Jigsaw is first in the timeline because it takes place both before and after the events of Saw." Its barn game took place "ten years earlier … before the events of the first film". The present-day portion is used for ordering.

title: Spiral
notes: Also subtitled From the Book of Saw. studio_or_developer holds the infobox distributor; production companies not checked.

in_universe.label: unknown time after John Kramer's death
in_universe.note: Spiral takes place an unknown amount of time after John's death, as another Jigsaw copycat creates their own games to punish corrupt police officers and detectives. Last in the chronology table. Spiral lead: "It serves as a spin-off and the ninth installment of the Saw film series". The exact phrase "set in the Saw universe" was not found in either article.
